subject: Request: trial safety-net due to integration queue delay
messages:
Date: Fri, 7 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
From: Ethan James <ethan.james@acmeretail.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lydia Park <lydia.park@acmeretail.com>
Subject: Integration backlog — request for trial safety-net

Hi Naomi / Ben,

Quick note from our eng team: we hit a persistent webhook mismatch in staging that stalled the pipeline for the Acme Checkout connector. Our engineers are queued on a fix but the timeline slipped — likely another 10 business days. Given this, we won’t be able to show a meaningful demo before our onboarding trial credits run out.

Can Redwood provide a short runway (30 days) or a sandbox top-up so we can complete the integration and evaluate throughput? This is the primary gating item for our procurement team.

Attaching the short failure log we collected (integration-error.log) to show the blocker.

Appreciate any flexibility here — this is time-sensitive for our Q3 rollout.

Thanks,
Ethan James
Senior Platform Engineer, Acme Retail
ethan.james@acmeretail.com

---
attachment: integration-error.log (8 KB, text)
Date: Fri, 7 May 2027 10:03:15 -0700
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
To: Ethan James <ethan.james@acmeretail.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
Subject: Re: Integration backlog — request for trial safety-net

Hi Ethan — thanks for the details and for sending the log. Sorry to hear the webhook mismatch is blocking you.

We can absolutely provide a runway to avoid losing momentum. Proposed options:
- 30-day trial extension (no-cost) OR
- one-off sandbox top-up (additional 20k tokens) + 15-day extension

Which would be most helpful from a testing perspective? If you confirm, I’ll loop in our finance/ops and get the paperwork queued. We can also schedule a quick sync with our integration engineer if your team wants paired debugging.

If helpful, we can attach a short amendment to the trial that both sides sign (simple one-pager).

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
naomi@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0142

Date: Fri, 7 May 2027 11:22:37 -0700
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
Subject: Re: Integration backlog — request for trial safety-net

Looping in Kimberly for approval on the extension/top-up. Deal context: Acme is in pilot for a multi-market rollout; if we keep momentum they’re on a $200k ARR path. No past credits abused; this looks like a genuine engineering queue issue.

Naomi — prefer to offer the 30-day no-cost extension to keep friction low unless finance wants to condition it. If you think the 20k token top-up is necessary to exercise throughput tests, we can do that instead.

Kimberly — flagging impact to revenue velocity. Happy to take this to approval but wanted you in the loop.

Thanks,
Ben
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Date: Fri, 7 May 2027 13:01:02 -0700
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
Subject: Re: Integration backlog — request for trial safety-net

Thanks for the context. Approved.

Decision: Provide a 30-day no-cost trial extension and mark the account as "runway-safety-net" in the CRM. Condition: Acme needs to complete the SOC2 questionnaire and confirm a demo slot within the extension window — we’ll use that to prioritize a dedicated integration engineer slot if needed.

Naomi — please document the amendment and route to Legal for a quick sign-off (one-pager). Ben — update the forecast to show potential close window shifted by ~3 weeks.

Kimberly Park
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:10:45 -0700
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
To: Ethan James <ethan.james@acmeretail.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
Subject: Re: Integration backlog — request for trial safety-net

Hi Ethan — good news: we approved a 30-day no-cost extension for Acme Retail to keep your pilot window intact.

Actions and next steps:
- Extension period: 30 days starting today (10 May 2027).
- Condition: Please complete the SOC 2 intake questionnaire (link: https://redwood.ai/soc2-intake) and confirm a demo slot by May 20 so we can schedule an integration pairing session.
- I attached the short amendment (trial-adjustment-agreement.pdf) — signature will be handled via DocuSign if you confirm.

If you prefer the token top-up instead of the extension, let me know and I’ll switch to that flow.

Thanks — we’ll keep a dedicated engineer on standby once you lock the demo.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Integration backlog — request for trial safety-net

Naomi / team — hugely appreciated. We completed the SOC2 intake earlier today and signed the amendment in DocuSign; Lydia will confirm the demo slot by Wednesday. The extra runway removes a lot of pressure on our rollout plan.

I’ll follow up with a short post-mortem on the webhook mismatch once my team wraps the patch — happy to share learnings with your integration engineers.

Thanks again,
Ethan
